# Refine Requirement

## Inputs
- User request
- Current requirement IDs and related ADRs

## Procedure
1. Restate user outcome and non-goals.
2. Resolve ambiguity with explicit assumptions.
3. Define business rules and edge cases.
4. Define measurable acceptance criteria.
5. Capture privacy, safety, and AI implications.

## Output Contract
- Requirement delta (added/updated/deprecated IDs)
- Acceptance criteria list
- Testability notes
- Traceability updates required
